_doc: Model ids the server can serve (docs/server.md 1b). --model-id ID picks the first pack of ID's list that is complete; --pack DIR overrides. '@IJAH_PACKS/' = the packs directory (env IJAH_PACKS, default ~/.cache/ijah/packs); download a pack with: hf download SiliconSpecies/<name> --local-dir <IJAH_PACKS>/<name>. A pack with trunk6 metadata is complete when all 48 layers are converted and the bf16 mixer is in.

Swift-1.5-Flash-Next-native-dflash._doc: The same Swift-1.5 weights, served with the DFlash2 block drafter on (+7-10% decode, docs/mtp.md 13). The drafter is a server start flag, so it is a model id here: clients pick it with `model`. Start it with tools/serve.sh start -- --mtp 5 --drafter dflash2 --drafter-path ~/.cache/ijah/drafters/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2 (hf download incoai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2 --local-dir that path). A server started without --drafter does not advertise this id, and a plain id on a drafter server is refused, so a drafter run and its control cannot be confused (docs/server.md 13). The drafter is Inco's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2 (Apache-2.0); it drafts Swift-1.5, the fine-tune of the same architecture.
